notes: §1985:XII.3.4 GR7 (Amendment 2): comment and blank lines in the source and in pseudo-text-1 "are ignored for purposes of matching", those of pseudo-text-2 are placed into the resultant program, and one inside the matched source words "is not placed into the resultant program". FixedFormConverter turns a * or / comment line and a blank line into no text-words, TextWordScanner treats what is left of a comment as a space, so ApplyReplacements matches across them and replaces the whole matched span (lines included) by pseudo-text-2 as written; ForbiddenIn does not refuse the comment of a written pseudo-text-2 at 85 (probe g5d). Witness: a comment and a blank line inside DISPLAY ... "A" still match (B). Probes (classes b, d): a comment and a blank line inside pseudo-text-1, a / line and a blank line inside the matched source, a comment inside pseudo-text-2 and an empty * line (g7a: 2, B).

next.reason: Amendment 2 (X3.23b-1993) changed the last sentence from 'is not replaced' to §1985:XII.3.4 GR7 'is not placed into the resultant program if that comment line or blank line appears within the sequence of text words that match pseudo-text-1'. 2023 agrees with that sentence and with the matching part ('are ignored for purposes of matching'): §2023:6.5 GR2 'If the line is a comment line or a blank line, that line is logically discarded', applied to fixed form by §2023:6.1 GR2 a) ('as though the lines had been logically converted from fixed form to free form'), and §2023:7.2.4.4 GR8 c) 6 'Comments, if any, are treated as a single space'. The result still differs for pseudo-text-2: 1985 'Comment lines or blank lines in pseudo-text-2 are placed into the resultant program unchanged'; §2023:7.2.4.4 GR9 the text REPLACE produces 'shall not contain a COPY statement, a REPLACE statement, a SOURCE FORMAT directive, a comment, or a blank line'. The resultant text differs; the compiled program's meaning does not.
